name: keepmind
description: KeepMind — open-source installable second brain. Connects your apps, remembers everything, learns while you sleep.

scripts.start:headless: electron-vite build && xvfb-run -a env SECOND_BRAIN_HEADLESS=1 electron .
scripts.dist:corp: KEEPMIND_EDITION=corp electron-vite build && npm run corp:prepare-desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.corp.yml
scripts.dist:corp:mac: KEEPMIND_EDITION=corp electron-vite build && npm run corp:prepare-desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.corp.yml --mac dmg zip
scripts.dist:corp:win: KEEPMIND_EDITION=corp electron-vite build && npm run corp:prepare-desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.corp.yml --win nsis --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:corp:linux: KEEPMIND_EDITION=corp electron-vite build && npm run corp:prepare-desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.corp.yml --linux AppImage --x64
scripts.dist:mac: electron-vite build && node scripts/prune-onnxruntime.mjs darwin && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.dist:win: electron-vite build && node scripts/prune-onnxruntime.mjs win32 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:linux: electron-vite build && node scripts/prune-onnxruntime.mjs linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64

author: KeepMind contributors
